title: Great Love
story:
A little boy once stood on the seashore with his father.

He looked at the vast ocean.

Waves kept coming again and again.

He asked,

“Does the ocean ever end?”

His father smiled and said,

“No, it is very large. It seems endless to us.”

The boy stood quietly for a long time.

He said,

“It feels like it touches the sky.”

His father nodded.

In life, we often try to measure love.

Human love has limits.

People fail us.

People change.

But God’s love is different.

It is vast like the ocean.

Higher than the sky.

It never runs out.

It never fails.

It reaches beyond what we can imagine.
life_lesson:
God’s love is vast, unchanging, and beyond human limits.

You are always surrounded by His love.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your unfailing love.

Help me to understand how wide and deep Your love is.

When I feel unloved or alone, remind me that You are always near.

Let me rest in Your great love today.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you sometimes feel unloved or forgotten?

How does God’s endless love change your perspective?

How can you rest in His love today?
verse:
Your love, Lord, reaches to the heavens,
Your faithfulness to the skies.
